title: Triata Capital Monica Hsiao：美联储加息概率90%？市场预期或过于激进
speaker: Monica Shell

segments.en: Fed's coming up this week and as far as markets go it's almost a foregone conclusion that they're going to hike interest rate. Let's call it 90% probability based on Fed fund futures or swaps, pick your poison here
segments.zh: 美联储本周即将召开会议，市场几乎认定加息已成定局。根据联邦基金期货或互换合约，概率约为90%，信哪个由你选。

segments.en: that they are going to hike interest rates. This week let's get a sense of whether or not markets are getting this one. The telemetry on this one accurately Monica Shell is with us founder and CIO
segments.zh: 他们将会加息。本周我们来了解一下市场是否真的消化了这一点。精准解读这一信号的是 Monica Hsiao，她是 Triata Capital 的创始人兼首席信息官。

segments.en: Triata Capital. So what do you make of these odds? So I think that now after the data I think it's more likely than not that they would hike but I don't think it's a foregone conclusion. So 90% probability in my opinion is a bit high.
segments.zh: Triata Capital。你如何看待这些概率？我认为，在数据公布后，他们更有可能加息，但我不认为这是板上钉钉的事。所以在我看来，90%的概率有点高了。

segments.en: I probably if you force me to pin a number I would say it's like 65 to 70 percent and maybe this nuance doesn't matter to people but actually I think it matters as to our concept of the forward projections.
segments.zh: 如果你非要我给出一个数字，我会说大概在65%到70%之间。也许这个细微差别对一些人来说不重要，但实际上我认为它关系到我们对前瞻性预测的理解。

segments.en: Do you think the motivation is in some ways to restore some credibility as well beyond just the whole stabilization of prices and the like? I think given Worsh's talk at Jackson Hole there is something to be said about credibility
segments.zh: 你认为动机在某种程度上也是为了恢复一些公信力，而不仅仅是稳定物价之类的吗？我认为鉴于沃什在杰克逊霍尔的讲话，公信力确实值得一谈。

segments.en: but in particular because of the way that market has priced it and what I'm looking at is not just the 90% probability in the front end but more so you know what are the consequences if they don't hike to the long end
segments.zh: 但特别是因为市场的定价方式，我关注的不仅仅是前端90%的概率，更重要的是，如果他们不加息，对长端会有什么后果。
